claim_text: An EF rating is a damage-based estimated 3-second gust and not a turbine-local measured intensity.

update_trigger: Final wind-speed-estimation standard supplies a governed conversion.

prohibited_inference: Claim exact rotor wind, probability, modern-fleet transfer, or repair cost.

update_trigger: Final turbine DI or additional matched turbine cases.

prohibited_inference: Universal turbine capacity, exact hub speed, or fitted beta from unreported counts.
reasoning: All below 65 survived, all at/above 69 toppled, mixed between; research is ongoing.
